استمسكوا (form X)
# اِسْتَمْسَكُوا (istamsakū) /is.tam.sa.kuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَمْسَكَ (istamsaka)
# اِسْتَمْسِكُوا (istamsikū) /is.tam.si.kuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَمْسَكَ (istamsaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
